label: Finalidade da prática
definition: Função principal da atividade no percurso e na interpretação de seus resultados.
precedence: accessibility/legal > consent > research protocol > institution > author > learner preference > default
recommendation: Exigir valor explícito; usar formative-learning no perfil AraLearn.
incompatibilities: summative-assessment with unrestricted reveal or unlimited retry
analytics_implication: Purpose is required to interpret events and scores; purpose does not authorize collection.
accessibility_implication: Accommodations must preserve or explicitly qualify the construct.

label: Demanda cognitiva da resposta
definition: Operação exigida do estudante, independentemente do controle visual usado.
precedence: research protocol or institutional assessment may lock; accessibility may supply equivalent expression
recommendation: Representar separadamente do formato e da pontuação.
incompatibilities: none intrinsically
analytics_implication: Required for comparing practice and outcome measures.
accessibility_implication: Alternative expression is allowed when it preserves the target construct; otherwise record accommodation effect.

label: Forma da resposta
definition: Estrutura canônica pela qual a resposta é registrada.
precedence: accessibility accommodation can override UI but not silently rewrite canonical meaning
recommendation: Aceitar catálogo extensível; não inferir demanda cognitiva apenas pelo formato.
incompatibilities: unsupported capability
analytics_implication: Events should record canonical form only when authorized.
accessibility_implication: Every form requires keyboard, screen-reader, reflow and non-drag alternatives where applicable.

label: Política de validade
definition: Determina se e como a entrada é distinguida como ausente, inválida, válida ou não avaliável antes da correção.
precedence: capability contract applies; research protocol may lock interpretation
recommendation: Separar validade de correção; exigir estados explícitos para respostas estruturadas e abertas.
incompatibilities: binary-only systems may not expose validity detail
analytics_implication: Validity events are not evidence of learning.
accessibility_implication: Invalid-state messages must identify and explain correction accessibly.

label: Autoridade de avaliação
definition: Agente ou mecanismo com autoridade para emitir o estado de avaliação.
precedence: legal/ethics and protocol constraints precede author; probabilistic assistance never silently becomes final
recommendation: Deterministic where suitable; human or hybrid for open work; probabilistic output nonfinal by default.
incompatibilities: probabilistic-assistance as sole high-stakes authority
analytics_implication: Record evaluator identity/version and review status when collection is authorized.
accessibility_implication: Human contestation and accessible explanation are required for consequential decisions.

label: Política de crédito
definition: Como correção, parcialidade, tentativas e rubrica se convertem em crédito.
precedence: summative institution or protocol may lock; learner preference cannot alter awarded grade
recommendation: Preservar none/binary no perfil AraLearn; permitir crédito parcial apenas com semântica explícita.
incompatibilities: unexplained partial credit; cross-format score comparison
analytics_implication: Credit formula, units and limitations must be versioned.
accessibility_implication: Credit must not penalize use of an approved accommodation unless construct impact is explicit.

label: Limite de tentativas
definition: Número de submissões permitidas antes da conclusão, revelação, bloqueio ou handoff.
precedence: accessibility accommodation may extend; protocol or summative policy may lock
recommendation: Default AraLearn: nonpunitive and not used as mastery measure; make limit explicit in other profiles.
incompatibilities: unlimited with high-stakes best-score unless justified
analytics_implication: Attempt count is collected only under an approved question and retention rule.
accessibility_implication: Extra attempts may be an accommodation; interface must not expose attempt pressure unnecessarily.

label: Sequência entre tentativas
definition: Informação recebida e ação permitida between one response and the next.
aralearn_value: check or reveal followed by learner-controlled retry
precedence: purpose and consequence constrain available sequences
recommendation: Representar explicitamente; recommend hint or elaborated retry for formative profiles and lock-after-submit only for measurement needs.
incompatibilities: correct-answer-retry when independent measurement is still intended
analytics_implication: Sequence events require protocol-specific capture; do not infer effort from count.
accessibility_implication: Focus, announcements and retained input must support error recovery.

label: Alvo da nova tentativa
definition: Se a nova tentativa usa o mesmo item, variante equivalente, etapa específica ou revisão posterior.
precedence: protocol may lock equivalence criteria
recommendation: Aceitar como parâmetro; não selecionar padrão universal até P2 e estudos de domínio.
incompatibilities: same-item after full reveal when independent retrieval is claimed
analytics_implication: Equivalent-item identity and reuse must be recorded if used in research.
accessibility_implication: Alternative target must remain navigable and understandable.

label: Acesso a pistas
definition: Quem inicia a pista, quando ela aparece e se escala por tentativa.
precedence: accessibility support may override; protocol may lock within consent
recommendation: Recommend learner-request or staged hints for formative profiles; no universal automatic hint.
incompatibilities: hint that reveals answer while counted as independent response
analytics_implication: Hint use is not a deficit marker; collect only for a defined question.
accessibility_implication: Hints must be perceivable in equivalent modalities and not depend on color, hover or drag.

label: Gatilho de revelação
definition: Condição em que a resposta, solução ou modelo pode ser shown.
precedence: purpose and stakes constrain; accessibility does not remove access to correction but may change timing
recommendation: Preserve learner-request in AraLearn profile; recommend after-attempt or learner-request for formative use; restrict in summative measurement.
incompatibilities: unrestricted reveal before consequential submission
analytics_implication: Reveal requests are not failure evidence.
accessibility_implication: Reveal control requires clear label, confirmation only when consequence is material, and accessible focus handling.

label: Conteúdo revelado
definition: Quantidade e tipo de information exposed by reveal.
aralearn_value: canonical answer plus after explanation where authored
precedence: capability and content contract constrain; protocol may lock
recommendation: Separate correct response from explanation; recommend concise answer plus actionable explanation for formative profile.
incompatibilities: rubric or hidden tests exposed before consequential completion
analytics_implication: Record content version, not merely reveal event, in reproducible research.
accessibility_implication: Provide text alternatives and avoid inaccessible-only solution representations.

label: Feedback de resultado
definition: Whether correctness, partiality, validity or review status is communicated.
precedence: purpose and evaluation authority constrain
recommendation: Keep independent from content feedback; correctness-only is permitted but not preferred as sole formative feedback.
incompatibilities: result shown before locked summative submission
analytics_implication: Result event alone does not establish learning.
accessibility_implication: Status must be conveyed programmatically and not by color alone.

label: Conteúdo do feedback
definition: Pedagogical information accompanying or following the result.
aralearn_value: canonical after explanation; local option feedback optional
precedence: protocol may lock; learner can control display in personal profile
recommendation: Recommend concise elaborated feedback; allow layered composition; do not equate length with quality.
incompatibilities: probabilistic error diagnosis presented as fact
analytics_implication: Feedback type and source must be recorded for research.
accessibility_implication: Feedback must be actionable, plain-language, programmatically associated and available in accessible formats.

label: Momento do feedback
definition: Temporal or item-relative position in which feedback becomes available.
precedence: summative and protocol locks precede learner preference; personal profile may choose
recommendation: No universal winner; default immediate/after-attempt for low-consequence deterministic practice, with explicit alternatives.
incompatibilities: timing label without quantified delay or event reference
analytics_implication: Record actual availability time only when authorized and needed.
accessibility_implication: Time delays and notifications must not create inaccessible deadlines.

label: Persistência do feedback
definition: How long feedback remains available and where it can be revisited.
aralearn_value: available in current card after interaction; canonical after content persists
precedence: privacy and retention constraints precede author preference
recommendation: Recommend card-persistent canonical explanation in personal study; defer event-history retention to #5.
incompatibilities: persistent sensitive human feedback without access policy
analytics_implication: Persistence is content availability, not automatic event retention.
accessibility_implication: Learners need predictable re-access without relying on transient toast messages.

label: Nível de consequência
definition: Effect of a response or score on progress, grade, access, certification or external decision.
aralearn_value: structural progress only; no grade or ranking
precedence: legal/ethics > consent > research protocol > institution > author; learner preference controls personal use only
recommendation: AraLearn default none/structural-progress; consequential assessment must be separate and explicit.
incompatibilities: high-stakes with probabilistic sole authority or unrestricted reveal
analytics_implication: Consequences require question, formula, access and prohibited-inference record.
accessibility_implication: Accommodations, review and appeal are mandatory for consequential use.

label: Visibilidade de pontuação
definition: Who sees item, set or aggregate scores and when.
precedence: privacy/consent precede institutional visibility; public visibility is never default
recommendation: Default learner-only or hidden; no ranking or public comparison in first profile.
incompatibilities: public or peer-visible individual scores without explicit purpose and consent
analytics_implication: Visibility is distinct from collection and retention.
accessibility_implication: Score presentation must include meaning and limitations, not color-only status.

label: Agregação de tentativas
definition: How multiple responses are combined into an official result.
precedence: consequence policy controls; learner cannot change official aggregation
recommendation: Accept dimension, defer default selection; prohibit silent highest-score or average across unlike formats.
incompatibilities: cross-format aggregation without calibration
analytics_implication: Formula and attempt eligibility must be versioned.
accessibility_implication: Aggregation must account for approved accommodations and avoid penalizing them without construct justification.

label: Acomodação de resposta
definition: Approved alternative input, navigation or expression method used to remove barriers.
aralearn_value: textual structured resources with keyboard-oriented controls; no general accommodation model
precedence: legal/accessibility and participant rights precede course or protocol; construct impact must be documented
recommendation: Structural requirement; define as overlay, not ordinary pedagogical preference.
incompatibilities: denial of required accommodation; silent construct change
analytics_implication: Accommodation use is sensitive data and not ordinary analytics.
accessibility_implication: Must work with assistive technology and retain clear instructions, error identification and correction.

label: Política de tempo de resposta
definition: Whether response time is unconstrained, limited, extendable or accommodated.
precedence: accessibility requirement overrides unless time is the construct and an ethical alternative is defined
recommendation: Preserve unlimited in AraLearn profile; time limits require explicit construct and consequence rationale.
incompatibilities: nonessential fixed limit without extension path
analytics_implication: Timing events are collected only under approved protocol.
accessibility_implication: Warn before expiry, allow extension where possible and preserve entered response.

label: Captura de eventos de tentativa
definition: Whether and which attempt-level events are persisted for personal analytics or research.
precedence: consent, withdrawal, minimization and retention precede all collection
recommendation: Defer normative fields to P4/#5; preserve none as AraLearn reference and prohibit convenience collection.
incompatibilities: feature availability interpreted as collection permission
analytics_implication: Attempt data may be sensitive and must not become attention, effort or ability inference by default.
accessibility_implication: Accessibility interactions must not be used to profile disability without explicit lawful purpose.

label: Registro de confiança
definition: Whether the learner reports confidence in a response before feedback.
precedence: research protocol may lock within consent; accessibility can alter control
recommendation: Defer to P3/P4; evidence shows diagnostic value but repeated prompts may add burden.
incompatibilities: required confidence in every low-friction practice
analytics_implication: Confidence is not correctness or competence and needs its own construct.
accessibility_implication: Offer accessible scale and skip unless methodologically required.

label: Ranking e comparação social
definition: Whether individual performance is ordered or shown relative to others.
precedence: institutional use would require later strategic decision, ethics and UX review
recommendation: Reject from first taxonomy version as active capability; preserve none as default and revisit only with focused evidence.
incompatibilities: public ranking in personal or research profiles
analytics_implication: Ranking changes motivation and behavior and cannot be inferred as learning benefit.
accessibility_implication: High exclusion, anxiety and accessibility risks.
